sections.label: Public waste collection contracts
sections.summary: Public waste collection contracts cover recyclables collection under the National Recycling Programme and waste collection, charged as one fee paid by households.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Public waste collection (PWC) contracts cover both the collection of recyclables, under the National Recycling Programme (NRP), and the collection of waste.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The public waste collectors charge a single fee for both waste and recycling collection, which is paid by households as the monthly refuse collection fee.

sections.label: Recyclables collected and recycling measures
sections.summary: Public waste collectors collected about 44,200 tonnes of recyclables in 2016, up from 2014 and 2015, with new recycling requirements for developments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In 2016, the public waste collectors collected about 44,200 tonnes of recyclables.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: This was an increase from 2014 and 2015, when about 31,000 tonnes and 37,000 tonnes of recyclables were collected respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: My Ministry continues to look at how we can improve recycling rates in the domestic sector, where the recycling rate has been hovering around 20% since 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For example, from 1 April this year, all new non-landed private residential developments above four storeys will need to provide dual chutes for refuse and recyclables.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: All existing condominiums will also have to provide one recycling bin per block from 1 August this year.

sections.label: 2016 recyclables collection under NRP
sections.summary: The 44,200 tonnes collected in 2016 is just the collection of recyclables under the National Recycling Programme by public waste collectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding the 44,200 tonnes collected in 2016, it is just the collection of recyclables under NRP carried out by the public waste collectors.
